_comment: Lens system — see docs/design/lens-system-and-evolutions-proposal.md (canonical) + lens-system-addendum-2026-07-27.md. Layer 3 of the character model (Primary locked / Secondary job / Lens). struktured ruling 2026-07-27: Lenses are POOLED — crafted into shared inventory, equippable by ANY party member, never bound to a killer. Acquisition is: defeat a masterite of this axis -> recipe unlocks -> gather materials -> craft -> equip.
_stat_mod_vocabulary: stat_mods keys match PassiveSystem.get_passive_mods exactly (attack_multiplier, defense_multiplier, magic_multiplier, speed_multiplier, max_hp_multiplier, max_mp_multiplier, mp_cost_multiplier, healing_multiplier, crit_chance, evasion). Multipliers compose multiplicatively; crit_chance/evasion add. Lenses are deliberately NOT stored in passives.json: AbilitiesMenu.gd:116 has `or true` stubbed into its learned check, so any passive listed there is equippable by anyone with no crafting gate.
_axis_fingerprint: Stat tilts here follow cowir-battle's measurement of what the 20 live masterites ACTUALLY do (msg 3178), not the original doc's sketch. Two of the doc's four tilts were derived from ability TYPE and mislead: Tempo's abilities are 20/25 support (haste/slow/time_tax) so +SPD is the stat it MANIPULATES, not its identity; Curator's 'magic' is mana_drain/audit/dispel/resource_cut, which attack resources rather than HP, so +MAG misreads it. For those two the passive carries the identity and the stat tilt is deliberately absent.

warden.name: Warden Lens
warden.description: You have been hit by something that did not intend to stop. Now neither do you.
warden.flavor: The Warden does not out-damage you. It outlasts you, and then it punishes.
warden.passive_description: Survive one otherwise-lethal blow per battle at 1 HP.

arbiter.name: Arbiter Lens
arbiter.description: A verdict is not louder than an argument. It is only final.
arbiter.flavor: The Arbiter carries the highest physical share of any axis, and its execution ability triples against the wounded.
arbiter.passive_description: Deal +50% damage to enemies below 25% HP.

tempo.name: Tempo Lens
tempo.description: Speed was never the point. The point was whose turn it is.
tempo.flavor: 20 of Tempo's 25 ability slots are support — haste, slow, time tax. It manipulates the action economy; it barely fights.
tempo.passive_description: When you act, the next ally action this round costs 1 less AP.

curator.name: Curator Lens
curator.description: It is not taking your life. It is taking your options, and keeping a record.
curator.flavor: Every Curator 'magic' ability is a resource attack wearing damage clothing — mana drain, audit, dispel, resource cut.
curator.passive_description: Gain 1 MP whenever a party member spends MP. Debuffs land 25% less often on you.
